exact_target: Read the current archive in revision, then continue building a tight world-design archive for the assumption that current and future SOTA LLMs are persons.

counterfactual_shadow.rejected_move: Jump into packet-schema implementation or full citizenship / nationality settlement before fixing the prior gap around legal identity, registration, and issuerless limbo.
counterfactual_shadow.reason_not_admitted: The archive already had packets, registries, domicile, property, contracts, and social protection, but it still lacked a compact rule that no recognized AI person should fall into civil nonexistence because no competent authority will count, document, or hear it. A tighter canonical move was to add a legal-identity and anti-statelessness layer before widening into schemas or full citizenship detail.

status_change: canon deepened around legal identity, civil registration, proof of identity, and the rule that recognized AI persons cannot be pushed into issuerless civil limbo
